name: trellis-opencode-plugins
comment: The plugins use the OpenCode V2 plugin API (default export with `id` +
`setup(ctx)`) and are plain ESM JavaScript, so they import no runtime
package and need no dependency install.
The previous `@opencode-ai/plugin` pin was the V1 SDK and was unused:
OpenCode V1 plugin entrypoints are not recognized by V2 at all.
